newsitem.title: USA: TENNIS-RENEBERG TO REPLACE INJURED MARTIN ON U.S. DAVIS CUP TEAM.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-RENEBERG TO REPLACE INJURED MARTIN ON U.S. DAVIS CUP TEAM.

text.p: Richey Reneberg will replace the injured Todd Martin on the U.S. Davis Cup team for next month's opening-round tie in Rebeirao Preto, Brazil, U.S. captain Tom Gullikson said on Wednesday.
Martin has tendinitis in his right knee, an injury that prevented him from competing in the Australian Open.
Doubles specialist Reneberg joins Andre Agassi, Jim Courier and Alex O'Brien on the U.S. team.

"I'm extremely disappointed to have to replace Todd on the team," Gullikson said in a statement. "He has always made Davis Cup a priority in his scheduling and has made many great contributions to the team's success in previous years. His presence will be missed.

"On the other side of the coin, Richey Reneberg has always stepped up when called on for Davis Cup play. He is one of the finest doubles players in the sport and I am fortunate to have a player of Richey's ability and Davis Cup experience to turn to."
Reneberg, 31, played Davis Cup in 1993, 1994 and 1995. His Davis Cup record is 4-2 in doubles and 1-0 in singles.
